claims.text: The approach improves model interpretability by soliciting informative keywords from the crowd, providing human-understandable explanations for the model's performance.
Empirical demonstrations show that the approach enhances both accuracy and interpretability on multiple datasets, improving the state of the art by 24.3%.
The method outperforms traditional query expansion techniques in discovering informative keywords, which contributes to better interpretability.
